mistake_reason: At step 13, Orchestrator explicitly instructed the team to keep the workflow open and avoid finalizing despite having sufficient converging evidence from multiple sources (ResearchGate and archived personal page) that the earliest paper title was "Mapping Human Oriented Information to Software Agents for Online Systems Usage." This reflects FM-1.5 (Unaware of Termination Conditions): the agent failed to recognize stopping criteria, prohibited conclusion, and continued generating superfluous validation. The prolonged open-ended process caused drift toward an indexed-but-incorrect earliest title (the 2001 algorithm) and never triggered termination after meeting success metrics.
